text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The drag coefficient only dropped by
twenty-five
percent... But what if I
reduce the distance by five
percent...
Tch. What a total waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Another day of your obsession
with
numbers, I see. Ahhh, such
devotion!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The hell?! You tryin' to start a fight or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No... I simply can't help but wonder if
the answers
you seek can really be
found in the data you love
so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What will happen when your data and
numbers
prove ineffective? What if the
answer lies in
spiritualism or even pure
fantasy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you look, the kernel
of
knowledge you seek will evade you.
Will you still
peel back every layer of
the onion in hopes of
finding it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Onions are root vegetables.
Looking for a
kernel'd be pretty freakin'
stupid.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aaahahaha! Precisely! Another one of my
little
jokes, I must admit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But it seems my joke was able to disrupt
your
composure, if only for a moment.
Perhaps I could
disrupt your
performance on the track in the same

way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see you try... You're as crazy
as ever.
